text: こちらも　ポケモンを　もって　いれば　たたかえるのだが…　そうじゃ！

structure.jp: こちらも　ポケモンを　もって　いれば
structure.en: if we have a Pokémon too

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば after a verb means 'if' and gives the condition. もって　いれば = 'if (we) have'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: て plus いる says someone is in a state of doing something. ポケモンを　もっている = 'to have a Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is an old-man way of saying だ. そうじゃ = 'That's it!'.
